optimization.zh: 优化持续运行期间的更新发现，在前台、唤醒、网络恢复和周期触发中使用冷却合并与单次请求，避免高频轮询。
optimization.en: Improves update discovery while the App stays open, using cooldown coalescing and single-flight checks across foreground, wake, network recovery, and periodic triggers.

optimization.zh: 优化会话能力与设置的可信回读，隔离陈旧的模型、推理等级、Preset 和权限结果。
optimization.en: Improves trusted session capability and settings readback by isolating stale model, reasoning, preset, and permission results.

optimization.zh: 优化任务与能力轨迹投影，稳定展示工具、审批、提问、Subagent、恢复和终态，并提升长历史性能与安全脱敏。
optimization.en: Improves task and capability projection for tools, approvals, questions, subagents, recovery, and terminal states, with faster long-history handling and safer redaction.

fix.zh: 修复 App 长时间运行后无法主动发现随后发布更新的问题。
fix.en: Fixes the App failing to discover updates published after it has been running for an extended time.

fix.zh: 修复当前会话权限与未来会话默认权限混用，以及陈旧权限结果覆盖当前选择的问题。
fix.en: Fixes current-session permissions being confused with future defaults and stale permission results overriding the current choice.

fix.zh: 修复跨会话提交错投和迟到 AppKit/IME 回调恢复旧输入的问题。
fix.en: Fixes cross-session submission misrouting and late AppKit or IME callbacks restoring stale composer input.

fix.zh: 修复重建父会话历史时误删独立 Subagent 生命周期，以及迟到投影覆盖 durable final 或重复副作用的问题。
fix.en: Fixes parent-history rebuilds dropping independent subagent lifecycles and late projections overriding durable finals or repeating side effects.

fix.zh: 修复带语义元数据的 PDF 在 DEV 精确文件验收中被错误降级为文本的问题。
fix.en: Fixes PDFs with semantic metadata being incorrectly downgraded to text during exact-file DEV acceptance.

optimization.zh: 优化当前会话权限恢复，使用有界重试、冷却合并和单次请求机制，避免持续轮询。
optimization.en: Improves current-session permission recovery with bounded retries, cooldown coalescing, and single-flight requests without continuous polling.

optimization.zh: 优化权限选项异步加载，以会话、连接、选择和能力代际隔离陈旧结果。
optimization.en: Improves asynchronous permission loading by isolating stale results across session, connection, selection, and capability generations.

fix.zh: 修复已存在或已完成会话因权限状态晚到或缺失而长期停在加载中、无法继续的问题。
fix.en: Fixes existing or completed sessions remaining stuck in permission loading when the current projection arrives late or is unavailable.

fix.zh: 修复未来会话默认权限被误用作当前会话权限回退值的问题。
fix.en: Fixes the future-session default permission being used incorrectly as the current-session fallback.

fix.zh: 修复能力版本更新后权限菜单保留空选项，以及通用命令菜单被错误卡在加载中的问题。
fix.en: Fixes empty permission options after capability changes and command menus incorrectly remaining in a loading state.

fix.zh: 修复会话切换、连接恢复和取消竞态中陈旧权限结果覆盖当前选择的问题。
fix.en: Fixes stale permission results overriding the current choice during session switches, reconnection, and cancellation races.

optimization.zh: 优化 DOCX/RTF 工作台，使纯文本、Markdown、文稿与 PDF 四种视图共用同一可编辑内容源。
optimization.en: Improves the DOCX/RTF workbench so text, Markdown, document, and PDF views share one editable content source.

optimization.zh: 优化本地文件失败反馈，支持重试、关闭、用户操作优先级及会话代际失效，同时保持安全的内部预览路由。
optimization.en: Improves local-file failure feedback with retry, dismissal, user priority, and session-generation invalidation while preserving secure internal previews.

fix.zh: 修复 DOCX/RTF 仅进入只读降级页的问题，在工作区写权限下默认进入可编辑文稿并保留外部源。
fix.en: Fixes DOCX/RTF opening only in a read-only fallback; writable workspaces now use an editable document copy while preserving the external source.

fix.zh: 修复本地文件、图片或自动预览错误替换整个主对话的问题。
fix.en: Fixes local file, image, or automatic preview errors replacing the entire main conversation.

fix.zh: 修复自动后台失败覆盖用户主动文件失败的问题。
fix.en: Fixes automatic background failures overriding feedback from a user-initiated file action.

fix.zh: 修复陈旧异步重试进入错误会话，以及非初始错误被误当成整页历史失败的问题。
fix.en: Fixes stale asynchronous retries entering the wrong session and non-initial errors becoming full-page history failures.

fix.zh: 修复上游图片限制可能放宽 Rabbisir 本地安全上限的问题，超限附件会在提交前受控拒绝。
fix.en: Fixes upstream image limits overriding Rabbisir's stricter local cap, with over-limit attachments rejected before submission.

fix.zh: 修复缺失或伪造 Content-Length、解压膨胀及取消竞态，使超限响应只终止一次并安全失败。
fix.en: Fixes missing or forged Content-Length, decompression expansion, and cancellation races so oversized responses stop once and fail closed.

fix.zh: 修复陈旧浏览器跳转回调干扰当前页面的问题，并在所有结束路径清理有界 provisional 状态。
fix.en: Fixes stale browser navigation callbacks disturbing the current page and clears bounded provisional state on every terminal path.

fix.zh: 修复任务终态、停止与提交回读的竞态，避免已完成任务继续运行、停止报错或成功内容回填输入框。
fix.en: Fixes task completion, stopping, and submission readback races that could leave completed tasks running, report stop errors, or refill the composer.

fix.zh: 修复任务完成后的产物路由、重复打开和编辑抢焦点问题。
fix.en: Fixes artifact routing after completion, duplicate opening, and focus stealing while editing.

fix.zh: 修复退出或更新重启时未保存内容丢失，以及重连时待审批或待回答交互被清空的问题。
fix.en: Fixes unsaved-content loss during quit or update relaunch and preserves pending approvals or questions across reconnects.

fix.zh: 修复图片、RPC 与网络响应的内存边界，以及远程网页跳转本机回环地址或跨回环端口的问题。
fix.en: Fixes image, RPC, and network response bounds and blocks unsafe remote navigation into loopback or across loopback ports.

fix.zh: 修复 WebSocket 静默半开、公告刷新抖动和更新 URL 回环别名遗漏。
fix.en: Fixes silent half-open WebSockets, announcement refresh churn, and missed loopback aliases in update URLs.

optimization.zh: 优化纯文本、Markdown、文稿和 PDF 原生工作台，统一编辑、预览、保存与 A4 分页体验。
optimization.en: Improves the native text, Markdown, document, and PDF workbenches with consistent editing, preview, saving, and A4 pagination.

optimization.zh: 优化任务终态与输入提交流程，使停止、完成和中文输入在延迟回调与重连场景下更稳定。
optimization.en: Improves task completion and composer submission so stopping, completion, and Chinese input remain stable across delayed callbacks and reconnects.

optimization.zh: 优化任务产物的自动呈现与安全内部预览，避免重复标签、抢焦点或覆盖未保存编辑。
optimization.en: Improves automatic artifact presentation and secure internal previews while avoiding duplicate tabs, focus stealing, and unsaved-edit replacement.

optimization.zh: 优化长会话增量投影、有界缓冲与缺口修复，提升流式内容的响应和恢复可靠性。
optimization.en: Improves long-conversation incremental projection, bounded buffering, and gap repair for more responsive and reliable streaming recovery.

optimization.zh: 优化终端高输出、长会话流式内容、代码高亮、图片与 Artifact 预览的增量处理，提升长时间使用时的响应与资源稳定性。
optimization.en: Improves incremental handling for terminal output, long conversation streams, code highlighting, images, and artifact previews to improve responsiveness and resource stability.

optimization.zh: 优化运行时、会话与后台任务生命周期，降低重复解析、无界队列和残留进程风险。
optimization.en: Improves runtime, session, and background-task lifecycles to reduce duplicate parsing, unbounded queues, and lingering processes.

optimization.zh: 优化自动浏览预览缓存与界面热点，保留用户手动标签并改善导航、面板和输入区域的流畅度。
optimization.en: Improves automatic preview caching and interface hot paths while preserving manually opened tabs and smoothing navigation, panels, and composition.

fix.zh: 修复退出时终端进程组和端口未可靠释放的问题。
fix.en: Fixes terminal process groups and ports not being released reliably on exit.

fix.zh: 修复工作区文件预览中的路径竞态，并加强运行时来源完整性复核。
fix.en: Fixes a workspace file-preview path race and strengthens runtime provenance revalidation.

fix.zh: 修复 Keychain 保存后重启失败及文档元数据失败时状态提示不准确的问题。
fix.en: Fixes inaccurate status reporting when restart fails after Keychain storage or document metadata fails after content is saved.

fix.zh: 修复长会话流可能持续保活、辅助功能标签未随语言更新的问题。
fix.en: Fixes long-running conversation streams retaining state and accessibility labels not following language changes.

fix.zh: 修复中文输入法候选提交内容可能被旧草稿清空的问题。
fix.en: Fixes committed Chinese input-method text being cleared by a stale draft.

fix.zh: 修复短用户消息未按自然宽度贴右显示的问题。
fix.en: Fixes short user messages not using their natural right-aligned width.

fix.zh: 修复上一版本中已确认的问题。
fix.en: Resolves verified issues from the previous version.
